name: Ashley Dunstan
story: Ashley Dunstan of Hastings District Council co-presented the GIS response to the Havelock North water-contamination incident at the 2017 New Zealand Esri User Conference. The presentation records council GIS being used during a major public-health emergency rather than only for routine asset and planning work.
